editorialNotes: The reviewed Game Boy Kirby sprite is retained through independent 4K60 footage with explicit CC BY recording credit. An original 3D-volume illustration, per-vertex contour test and fist-only study carry the original educational roles; Cuphead drawn contours and Monster Hunter's sword rotation distinguish shape changes from apparent length due to viewpoint. Do not infer a commercial game's internal deformation method.

cup.title: Cuphead
cup.observed: Original drawn boss animation: large face opens its mouth, crescent leans forward, Grim/rider changes pose, small running player silhouette.

dream.observed: Green Greens. In the 44.5–51s section Kirby floats, lands on the step, expands, expels a star, briefly compresses to a flat outline at 48s, and jumps. Separate sprite contours recorded at native frame cadence. The 4K file includes the original presentation frame.
dream.audio: Muted; independent commentary and licensed music.
